title: Serial interface

fields.name: bitrate
fields.description: The bit rate for the communication. For example: 9600, 38400, 115200.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Absolute path to the device entry. For example, /dev/ttyS0.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify the format of the incoming data stream. The options are json and none. format and separator can't be used at the same time.

fields.name: min_bytes
fields.description: The serial interface expects at least min_bytes to be available before processing the message.

fields.name: separator
fields.description: Specify a separator string that's used to determine when a message ends.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own thread.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.

description: Fluent Bit input plugin: Serial interface.
